subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw add provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so what core/plugin contract and raw-media egress policy should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses user-facing upload UX, model capability metadata, provider routing, transport/auth boundaries, and security-sensitive media forwarding that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video input
options.body: Define a WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with size, retention, egress, and fallback rules, then land a repaired implementation against that contract.

options.title: Keep video in media understanding
options.body: Document the existing video.description path as the supported route and defer direct chat/model video uploads until later.

options.title: Start provider-specific
options.body: Let providers prove native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content type.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video input
recommendation.body: Define a WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with size, retention, egress, and fallback rules, then land a repaired implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest visible routing context on this issue and recent model-catalog/media architecture history for the contract decision.
